settings.poll_warning: Minimum 60 s — faster polling can make the battery unstable.
settings.experimental_hint: Turn on “Outage detection (experimental)” in Advanced to use these.
settings.tg_detect_none: No messages found — send a message to your bot first.
settings.tg_missing: Enter the bot token and chat ID first.
settings.tg_steps: Setup: 1) In Telegram, open your bot and send it any message (for example “hi”). 2) Click Detect: it fills in Chat ID and Your user ID. 3) Click Save.
settings.tg_command_info: Command /marstek: send it to your bot to get the current charge level, power, grid state and the time of the last reading. Only your user ID gets an answer. It works while this PC is on and Marstek Monitor is running.
settings.tg_user_missing: Your user ID is empty, so /marstek will not be answered. Click Detect (in a private chat it is the same number as the Chat ID).
help.language: Language of the app windows, notifications and Telegram messages.
help.autostart: Start Marstek Monitor automatically when you sign in to Windows.
help.shortcut: Keep a “Marstek Monitor” shortcut in the Start menu (for the packaged exe).
help.battery: The battery's address on your home network and its Local API port (set in the Marstek app, default 30000). “Rediscover” searches the network for the battery again, e.g. after your router gave it a new address.
help.poll: How often the app reads the battery. Faster than every 60 seconds is not allowed: it can make the battery's Local API unstable.
help.offline_after: How many readings in a row may fail before the app reports “Battery not responding”.
help.quiet: During these hours normal desktop notifications are not shown. They are still listed in the Events tab.
help.critical_bypass: Critical notifications (battery not responding, discharging blocked, temperature…) are shown even during quiet hours.
help.silence_telegram: Also hold back normal Telegram messages during quiet hours.
help.col_desktop: Show this notification on this computer.
help.col_telegram: Send this notification to Telegram (Telegram must be set up).
help.col_repeat: Remind again at this interval while the condition lasts. “off” = notify only once.
help.col_threshold: The value at which the notification fires.
help.priority: Critical: red mark, rings on the phone, ignores quiet hours. Normal: blue mark, arrives silently in Telegram.
help.test: Send a sample of this notification now through the selected channels.
help.rule.soc_below: Notifies when the charge level (SOC = State of Charge, how full the battery is, in %) drops below this value. It fires once, and again only after the level has risen above it by the re-arm margin (Advanced).
help.rule.soc_reached: Notifies when the charge level (SOC = State of Charge) reaches this value, e.g. 100% = fully charged.
help.rule.grid: Notifies when the grid power fails and the battery takes over, and when the grid comes back. Experimental: needs “Outage detection” in Advanced.
help.rule.backup_left: During an outage, notifies when the estimated backup time at the current load drops below this value. Experimental.
help.rule.charge_session: When a charge finishes: charge level from → to, duration and energy.
help.rule.discharge_session: When the battery stops supplying power: charge level from → to, duration and energy used.
help.rule.offline: The battery did not answer several readings in a row (General → Offline after), and later when it answers again.
help.rule.blocked: The battery itself refuses to charge or to discharge. If discharging is blocked, backup power will NOT work during an outage.
help.rule.temperature: The battery temperature is above the first value or below the second one.
help.rule.firmware: The battery's firmware version changed, e.g. after an update by Marstek.
help.rule.monitor: A Telegram message when this app starts and when it is closed, so you know whether monitoring is running.
help.tg_token: The token @BotFather gives you when you create your bot. Keep it secret.
help.tg_chat: Where the messages go. Filled in by “Detect”.
help.tg_user: Your personal Telegram ID. Only this user gets answers to /marstek. Filled in by “Detect”; in a private chat it is the same number as the Chat ID.
help.tg_answer: Reply to the /marstek command with the current battery status.
help.font: Size of all text in the app windows.
help.theme: Light or dark colors. “Follow Windows” uses your Windows setting.
help.preview: How the text looks with the chosen size.
help.power_sign: Which sign of the battery's power reading means charging. Change it only if the Now tab shows “Supplying” while the battery is charging.
help.counter_unit: Unit of the battery's lifetime energy counters. Change it if the Energy tab totals differ from the Marstek app by ×10, ×100 or ×1000.
help.counters_verified: Tick this after you checked that the totals match the Marstek app. It shows the efficiency card.
help.outage_detection: Experimental: recognizes grid outages from the battery data. Turn it on after the outage check in the verification checklist.
help.rearm_pct: After a charge-level notification fired, the level must move back by this many % before it can fire again. This prevents repeated notifications when the level hovers around a threshold.
help.rearm_c: The same for temperature notifications, in °C.
help.reserve: The charge level the battery never discharges below. Marstek's default discharge limit (DOD 88%) keeps 12% in the battery. Used to estimate how long backup power lasts during an outage.
help.efficiency: The share of the battery's energy that reaches the backup socket (the rest is lost in the inverter). Used for “time left” until the app has measured the real drain — after about 30 min of supplying power it uses the measured value instead.
help.retention: How long the per-minute readings (Live tab) are kept. Sessions, energy totals and events are kept separately.
help.log_level: How much detail the log file contains. Leave it at INFO unless you investigate a problem.
help.record_raw: Save every raw battery reply to a file in the logs folder. Useful for the verification checks.
help.open_folder: Opens the folder with the settings, history and log files.
